find: const unread = issue?.blockedByLoaded === false ? declared : Math.max(0, declared - seen);
why: Drops the whole unread-blocker accounting, so an issue GitHub says is blocked but whose blocker list was never fetched reports as READY. This is the single most damaging thing the #437 dependency view could get wrong: it would put blocked work on the executable frontier and send a maintainer to start something that cannot move. The `reconcile` path really does produce these records -- it marks every issue it did not inspect `blockedByLoaded: false` while the list payload still carries a blocker count -- so this is a reachable state and not a defensive branch.
killedBy: frontier: unknown is never ready refuses to call an issue ready when GitHub says it has blockers nobody read
